title: What is in this file?
description:
Guess what kind of data a file holds from its bytes.

```
save.dat: 4096 bytes, entropy 7.98 bits/byte -> compressed or encrypted
level.bin: entropy 3.1, "LVL1" at 0, repeating 12-byte records from 0x10
notes.txt: all printable -> text
```
hints: Entropy is `-sum(p * log2(p))` over the 256 byte values with `p = count / size` (lesson 1.05).
For a record size `n`, count how often byte `i` equals byte `i + n`; the size with the highest score is a good guess.
requirements: Look for a magic number at the start and for a record size where the data repeats a pattern (try sizes 4 to 64).
Use files made by your own programs or the course's samples.
stretch: Draw the entropy of each 256-byte block as a bar chart in text.
